en: a. feeling or showing that you are pleased and grateful for something; pleased that something bad has not happened
ex: I am thankful for all the help my friends gave me.
我很感謝朋友們給我的所有幫助。

en: n. a person who steals things from another person or place
ex: The thief ran away with her purse.
小偷拿著她的錢包跑掉了。

en: n. the feeling of needing or wanting to drink; a strong desire for something; vi. to feel the need to drink; to have a strong desire for something
ex: After hiking all day, he could hardly bear his thirst.
走了一整天的山路後，他幾乎無法忍受口渴。

en: a. feeling a need to drink; wanting something very much; (of land) very dry
ex: I feel very thirsty after running in the sun.
在太陽下跑步後，我覺得非常口渴。

en: n. an idea or opinion that you have in your mind; the act of thinking; the ability to think; a careful consideration; (past tense and past participle of think)
ex: She gave a lot of thought to her career choice.
她對自己的職涯選擇想了很多。

en: n. a long thin piece of cotton, wool or other material used for sewing; a series of connected ideas or events in a story; a spiral line on a screw; vt. to pass a thread through something; vi. to pass through a narrow space
ex: She pulled the thread through the eye of the needle.
她把線穿過針孔。

en: n. a statement that you will hurt someone if they do not do what you want; a person or thing likely to cause harm; a sign that something bad may happen
ex: Global warming is a serious threat to our planet.
全球暖化是對我們地球的嚴重威脅。

en: vt. to say that you will cause someone trouble or harm if they do not do what you want; to be a danger to something; vi. to seem likely to happen soon
ex: The company threatened to sue if we published the story.
公司威脅說如果我們刊登這則報導就要提告。

en: adv. in every part of a place; during the whole period of time; prep. in every part of; from the beginning to the end of
ex: The store has branches throughout the country.
這家商店在全國各地都有分店。

en: n. the short thick finger on the side of the hand; vt. to turn the pages of a book quickly; to try to get a ride in a passing vehicle by holding out the thumb; to use the thumb to move or handle something
ex: He hurt his thumb while hammering a nail.
他在釘釘子時傷到了拇指。
ph: stick out like a sore thumb

en: n. a loud noise in the sky during a storm, caused by lightning; a loud deep noise; vi. to make a loud deep sound; to shout angrily; vt. to say something in a loud angry voice
ex: We heard thunder in the distance before the rain began.
下雨前，我們聽見遠處傳來雷聲。

en: n. the regular rising and falling of the sea; a general direction of opinion or events; vi. to sail with the tide; vt. to carry something along with the tide
ex: The tide comes in twice a day.
潮水一天漲兩次。

en: prep. up to the time of; conj. up to the time when; vt. to prepare and use land for growing crops
ex: I'll wait here till you come back.
我會在這裡等到你回來。

en: n. wood used for building or making things; trees that are grown for use in building; vt. to cover or build with wood
ex: The house was built with timber from nearby forests.
這棟房子是用附近森林的木材蓋的。

en: a. extremely small
ex: A tiny ant was carrying a crumb across the floor.
一隻小螞蟻正扛著麵包屑穿過地板。

en: n. a thick rubber ring that fits around the wheel of a vehicle; vt. to make someone feel they need rest; to make someone bored; vi. to become tired or bored
ex: I need to change a flat tire on my bike.
我得換掉我腳踏車漏氣的輪胎。

en: n. a plant whose leaves are dried and used for smoking; cigarettes and other smoking products
ex: He gave up tobacco ten years ago.
他十年前就戒菸了。

en: n. a soft white food made from soybeans, used in Asian cooking and as a meat substitute
ex: She stir-fried tofu with vegetables for dinner.
她晚餐煮了蔬菜炒豆腐。

en: n. a unit of weight equal to 1,000 kilograms (metric ton) or 2,000 pounds (short ton); (informal) a large amount
ex: The truck can carry up to ten tons of sand.
這輛卡車最多可載十噸沙。
ph: hit like a ton of bricks

en: n. the quality of a sound, especially its pitch; the way that a person speaks that shows their feelings; the general mood of a place or situation; the shade of a color
ex: I didn't like his rude tone of voice.
我不喜歡他那粗魯的語氣。

en: n. the soft organ inside the mouth that is used for tasting, swallowing and speaking; a language; a particular way of speaking; vt. to touch or lick something with the tongue
ex: She burned her tongue on the hot soup.
她被熱湯燙到舌頭。

en: n. a pain in a tooth or teeth
ex: I have a terrible toothache and need to see a dentist.
我牙齒痛得很厲害，需要去看牙醫。

en: n. a small brush with a long handle used for cleaning your teeth
ex: Don't forget to bring your toothbrush on the trip.
旅行時別忘了帶牙刷。

en: vt. to throw something lightly or carelessly; to move something from side to side; to flip a coin to decide something; n. an act of throwing something lightly; the act of flipping a coin
ex: He tossed the keys onto the table.
他把鑰匙隨手丟到桌上。

en: a. strong and able to bear pain or difficulty; difficult to do or deal with; (of meat) hard to chew; strict or severe; n. a rough and violent person
ex: It was a tough decision, but we had to make it.
那是個艱難的決定，但我們非做不可。

en: n. a trip around a place to look at things of interest; a series of performances in different places; a period of duty; vi. to travel around a place for pleasure; vt. to visit a place as a tourist
ex: We took a guided tour of the old castle.
我們參加了這座古堡的導覽行程。

en: n. the business of providing services for people who are traveling for pleasure, such as hotels and tours; the activity of traveling for pleasure
ex: Tourism is an important source of income for the island.
觀光業是這座島嶼的重要收入來源。

en: vt. to pull a vehicle or boat with a rope or chain; to pull a car away because it was parked illegally; n. an act of towing; a rope or chain used for towing
ex: The police towed my car away because I parked illegally.
警方因我違規停車而把我的車拖走。

en: prep. in the direction of someone or something; in relation to or concerning; as a contribution to something; a. about to happen
ex: She walked toward the station.
她朝著車站走去。

en: n. a tall narrow building or part of a building; a structure for observing or communicating; vi. to be much taller than the things around
ex: The clock tower can be seen from every part of the city.
全市各處都看得到那座鐘塔。

en: n. a mark or sign that something has existed or been present; a very small amount of something; vt. to find or follow someone or something by looking for signs; to copy the outline of something; vi. to go back to a source
ex: The police found no trace of the missing man.
警方找不到那名失蹤男子的任何蹤跡。

en: n. a person who buys and sells goods or shares; a ship used in trade
ex: The trader sold goods at the local market.
那名商人在當地市場販售貨物。

en: n. a belief, custom or way of doing something that has been passed down for many years; the passing of customs from generation to generation; a story or legend passed down by word of mouth
ex: It's a family tradition to eat dumplings on New Year's Eve.
除夕吃餃子是我們家的傳統。

en: n. a device for catching animals or people; a trick that is used to cause someone to do something they do not want to do; vt. to catch an animal or person in a trap; to cause someone to be in a difficult situation; vi. to set traps
ex: The mouse was caught in a trap.
那隻老鼠被陷阱抓住了。

en: n. things that are thrown away because they are not wanted; something of very poor quality; vt. to throw something away; (informal) to destroy or criticize something strongly
ex: Please take out the trash before you go to bed.
睡前請把垃圾拿出去倒。

en: vi. to go from one place to another, usually over a long distance; to move or be passed along; vt. to go through or across a place; n. the activity of going from one place to another
ex: I love to travel and see new places.
我愛旅行，探索新地方。

en: n. a person who is traveling or who often travels; a traveling salesperson; a part that moves along a fixed track
ex: The traveler asked for directions to the train station.
那位旅客問了往火車站的路。

en: n. a collection of valuable things such as gold, silver or jewels; a person or thing that is greatly valued; vt. to value something very highly; to keep something carefully because it is important
ex: The pirates buried their treasure on a remote island.
海盜把他們的寶藏埋在一座偏遠的島上。

en: n. a group of people with the same ancestors, language and culture who live together in a particular area; a group of people who share the same interests
ex: The tribe has lived in the rainforest for hundreds of years.
這個部落在雨林中生活了數百年。

en: n. a clever or dishonest way of making someone believe something that is not true; a joke or something done to amuse people; a special skill or way of doing something; vt. to deceive someone by a clever or dishonest act; vi. to play tricks
ex: The magician performed a clever card trick.
魔術師表演了一個巧妙的紙牌戲法。
